notes.title: Stack Up! (or dive trying) Competitive Ladder Rewards + Sneak Peak for UPDATE 1
notes.notes:
Ciao Stackers,

It’s been a wild one! In the last month we saw Stack Up! reach the top 500 on Twitch, hit a peak of over 60,000 concurrent viewers beating games like Fall Guys on release weekend. It was truly exciting for us to see Stack Up! (or dive trying) get some attention and hit those milestones, and what’s been even better is hearing all your incredibly valuable feedback - so here’s an update: 

Competitive Ladder (Heightscores) Rewards for our Inaugural Season: 

We have already seen 100s of people across the world give it their all to edge their name on our global heighscores, and it’s nearly time to award the very best solo stackers in easy, medium and hard modes. 

Those who will finish in top place for each heightscore on September 1st 2021 will receive the following rewards: 


Easy: A total of 5 Hat or Hammer crates 
Medium: 5 Hat and 5 Hammer crates
Hard: The ultimate prize. Collaborate with the developers to create your very own hat and hammer set, to be fully immortalized in the game, forever!


Oh yes, you have less than two weeks to get yourself into the number one position, so get stacking now!

UPDATE ONE - Our First Major Update: 

We’ve heard your feedback. You asked for more power ups, more game modes, and more fun ways to play Stack Up! (or dive trying) together with your friends, so expect a major update coming your way this September - a full list of details on Update 1 will be shared in the next few weeks so, stay tuned :D

Note: The Heightscores will be reset when Update 1 comes out. 

That’s all for now - we look forward to sharing more with you very soon,

Your Favourite Italian Indie Devs,

PixelConflict

notes.title: Stack Up! Hotfix v1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hello Stackers,
Thanks for the constant feedback you are giving us through reviews and Discord (oh yeah, remember to join out official server), we've heard you and we worked on what you wanted most in the short run, here's the recap:


 Added resolution dropdown in options panel, this will display all the resolutions available for your monitor and you are free to pick whichever you like the most!
 Added Field Of View (FOV) slider in the options panel and ingame pause menu, values can be between 60 and 90
 Code improvements! Sometimes when we are tired, the code that comes out isn't the best, that's why it's always good to go back and optimize it!
 We also moved some UI buttons here and there

notes.title: Stack Up! Hotfix v1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hello Stackers,
New hotfix rolling out just now, some addition in the main menu and server minor changes, here's the recap:


 To help players find matches the server list has been reduced to 3 macro areas: "Americas", "Europe" and "Asia", remember that if you don't find a buddy stacker you can always join our Discord server
 Added tutorial button in main menu for players that didn't play it yet (cmon stackers, play the tutorial)
 Added a popup reminder when you have unopened crates in the inventory
 Fixed missing chinese font characters

notes.title: Stack Up! Hotfix v1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hello Stackers,
Quick update on the game, we have fixed some super duper annoying bugs, here's a quick recap:


 Fixed bug that made the rematch button visible for all and didn't work at times
 Fixed bug that prevented the host to play in custom mode
 Fixed translation spacing for some languages

notes.title: Stack Up! (or dive trying) is getting closer to release(yes, it’s out this year)
notes.notes:
Ciao everyone! Italian indie devs PixelConflict here. 

Over the past year and a half we have put a lot of love and hard work into our debut game, Stack Up! (or dive trying). We knew we were onto something when we couldn’t stop working on it during the first lockdown here in Italy, it brought us together day and night, gave us something to look forward to everyday, with the goal to one day share it with the world.

Well… it’s time! 

We wanted to give a big thank you to everyone who already downloaded and played our game’s demo in the past year. Your comments, feedback and encouragement have been incredible, we are so excited to show you everything we’ve put into Stack Up! since then. 

We’re working super hard to get the game over the line, and we’ll soon announce a date for the full release. We also have a ton of exciting new content, giveaways, and activities coming at you as we celebrate the launch. Make sure to stay tuned by following us on the links below, and come say hi on Discord or Reddit, we’d love to chat!

That’s all for now folks, 

Stay Stackin’

The PixelConflict devs

PS: Oh yeah, don’t forget to wishlist the game on Steam!
